technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
No technology description is provided because the dataset just describes the power plant portfolio of the respective country using current (2004) average technology per energy carrier.

# Included processes
It includes shares of national electricity production for the world (in 2008) at the busbar. It does not include transformation, transport nor distribution losses.
